title: Certified 39.1 percent centered inversion with a fully charged online B-tree

claims.statement: For uniform full-production fixed-G1 challenges, the online B-tree algorithm in proof.md returns a verified Q in G2 satisfying pairing(Q,P)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with probability at least 391/1000. Its total cold classical work, including every unsuccessful query, all insertions and splits, all routing and graph construction, arithmetic, output and verification, is <=2^(1057/8) reference equivalents under C=20000. Peak memory <=2^145 bytes; preprocessing <=2^(1057/8) equivalents included in total; nonuniform advice zero bytes. The finite indexed-neighbor word/message storage model is a material assumption. No production execution or physical provisioning is claimed.
